chunks: 42 – Naṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, Abū al-Qāsim, from the people of Balkh. A ghālī.

key_terms.بَلْخَ: Balkh, a city in Khorasan (modern Afghanistan)
key_terms.غَالٍ: Ghālī, a member of the Ghalat sect known for exaggerating the status of the Imams
key_terms.نَصْرُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ: Naṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, the narrator's name

ai.seo_question: Who is Naṣr ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ and what does the term 'ghālī' signify in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry identifies Naṣr ibn al-ᴻabbāḥ, a narrator from Balkh, noting his kunya (Abū al-Qāsim) and classifying him as a 'ghālī' (one of the Ghalat sects who exaggerated the status of the Imams).
